name: A/A batch for the noise floor
summary: An optional bench batch that runs the same arm twice as if it were two arms, to show the noise floor on this machine and repository before an A/B result is trusted. Recommended once per repository. Costs one extra arm pair; interleaving the arms alone is the simpler alternative.

evidence.setting: The ledger calls it E1-adjacent: a vendor-run study of eval infrastructure, not of an A/A batch
evidence.effect: Environment changes alone move agent scores by effect-sized amounts

killTest.pass: In the first 10 benches, at least one A/A result wider than the minimum detectable effect, or one decision changed
killTest.scheduled: Over the first 10 bench runs after bench v2 ships in v8.0; no date set

maintenance: Owned engine feature, maintained with the engine.
